relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: In the SNI-treated mice, CGRP infusion into either the left or right CeA reduced cold sensitivity in the left and right SNI-treated hindpaw

relationships.subject: CGRP 8-37
relationships.evidence_quote: while CGRP 8–37 infusion into the left or right CeA increased cold sensitivity in the right SNI-treated hindpaw only

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Neither CGRP nor CGRP 8-37 in the CeA had any significant effect on mechanical sensitivity in either neuropathic pain model.

key_findings: Intra-CeA CGRP reduced cold (not mechanical) sensitivity in SNI and paclitaxel neuropathy models, while CGRP 8-37 increased it in SNI mice.
CGRP effects depended on hemisphere and neuropathy etiology; CGRP reduced left CeA mEPSC frequency only with left SNI.
